limitations: The long-q compiled costs are q=1,2 affine extrapolations without an unused holdout for these schedule families.
The beta profiles are a predeclared diagnostic grid, not a continuous global optimization.
The exact-binomial counterfactual uses small-sector matrix signals and does not replace full RPE branch reconstruction.
PF coefficients remain empirical and are held fixed here; WP03 changes them next.
No state preparation, backend execution, noise model, or final total-cost evaluation is included.
